name: Ocean Overhaul
description: Adds 41 ocean-themed blocks (decorative prismarine, pearl, and sea glass sets, a full driftwood wood set, and the deep-ocean Abyssal Trench's glowing plankton, abyssal vents, and giant clams), the Tidal tool + armor sets, a deep-sea diving kit (Deep-Sea Helmet, Oxygen Tank, Flippers), the loyalty-throw Harpoon, a stockable Aquarium, Reef Fish + Jellyfish + Seahorse buckets, ocean foods, Megalodon Tooth + Abyssal Fang + Heart of the Kraken drops, seven naturally-spawning sea creatures (the Megalodon and Kraken bosses, the hostile Abyssal Lurker, Reef Fish, Jellyfish, the bucketable color-variant Seahorse, and the breedable beach-dwelling Shore Crab), and ambient bioluminescent plankton blooms with glowing disturbance trails, a crafted-only shipwreck decor set (anchor, ship’s wheel, climbable rope, tattered sail), spreading Living Abyssal Coral, pearl-growing giant clams, plus a dedicated Ocean Overhaul creative tab.
